why: B delivers the warm Nordic look the client described: light woods, a cream flatweave rug and cable-knit throw, green accents, a bamboo pendant and paper-cord armchairs, all forming one coherent palette against the oak floor. A drifts away from it with a walnut-tone coffee table, an ornate grey rug, black chairs and a boho black-and-white throw, though B's 70 cm coffee table is undersized for the sofa and its 140 cm dining table is snug for six.
